videos.title: The first true magnetic USB-C port?
videos.description:
The first true magnetic USB-C port? Microsoft says the Surface Laptop Ultra has one, and it's strong enough the cable practically plugs itself in! It uses magnets instead of latches,and the port is tapered, which means it won't stay plugged into gadgets without Microsoft's magnet pattern. But the cable's reversible so you can plug the magnet end into the charger or laptop and use the normal USB-C end on other stuff. Microsoft says it's patenting the idea.

videos.title: Torturing Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Ultra
videos.description:
We got to take a look at the secret lab where Microsoft tortures it's laptops until they're ready to ship. The new Surface Laptop Ultra is Microsoft's flagship laptop taking aim at the MacBook Pro. The RTX Spark chips inside the Surface Laptop Ultra are geared toward local AI workloads and creative tasks. A model with 24GB of RAM starts at $2,599.99, and if you want the very top of the line with 128GB of memory, you’re looking at $5,899.99.
